title: ThredUp Launches LIVE Shopping on TikTok Shop Ahead of the Holidays
summary: ThredUp’s live shows are building a community of resale shoppers: three in four live buyers are new to the brand, and shows are set to double in the coming weeks
body_markdown:
*ThredUp’s live shows are building a community of resale shoppers: three in four live buyers are new to the brand, and shows are set to double in the coming weeks*


**OAKLAND, Calif.,** November 18, 2026 — **ThredUp** (Nasdaq: TDUP, LTSE: TDUP), one of the world’s largest online fashion resale platforms, today announced the launch of live shopping on TikTok Shop, bringing shoppable livestreams of secondhand fashion to millions of U.S. shoppers. With the launch, ThredUp is one of the first major online resale platforms to bring secondhand fashion at every price point, from everyday brands to luxury designer labels, to TikTok Shop livestreams.


ThredUp currently hosts 10 live shows per week on TikTok Shop from studios inside its Atlanta and Dallas distribution centers, and plans to double that in the coming weeks. As live shopping grows, resale has come to mean everything from samples and overstock to truly pre-owned goods. ThredUp’s shows feature 100% secondhand items drawn from millions of unique pieces across more than 60,000 value, contemporary, and luxury brands. A shopper can find a $15 denim jacket and a designer handbag in the same stream.


*“Live shopping and resale belong together. Every secondhand item is one-of-a-kind, so every show becomes a treasure hunt,” said James Reinhart, CEO and co-founder of ThredUp. “Live shopping on TikTok Shop lets us meet the next generation of thrifters where they’re already discovering what to wear, just in time for the holidays. We believe this is just the beginning of a fundamental shift in how people discover and shop secondhand, and we intend to help lead it.”*


ThredUp hosts style pieces on camera and curate themed drops by brand or trend. Shoppers buy right in the stream without leaving TikTok, and each order ships directly from ThredUp’s distribution centers.


ThredUp entered live commerce on Whatnot in September, and early results are encouraging. Three in four buyers from its initial live shows were new to ThredUp, and items sold in those shows had a median selling price 52% higher than that of comparable items on ThredUp’s marketplace.


“ *Live gives secondhand something a product page can’t: a host who can give you a closer look, answer your questions in real time, and tell you what caught their eye about a piece,” said Danielle Vermeer, Head of Product at ThredUp. “That’s what draws new shoppers in. Over time, they get to know our hosts and return for their shows. That’s the connection we’re building through live, and TikTok Shop opens it up to even more shoppers.”*


TikTok Shop has become a significant channel for ThredUp, with more than 200,000 Clean Out Bags sold through the platform in 2026 to date.


The launch arrives during the busiest gifting season of the year, as secondhand becomes part of more holiday lists. According to[ThredUp’s 2026 Holiday Resale Report](https://newsroom.thredup.com/news/thredup-releases-2026-holiday-report) , 62% of Americans plan to buy at least one secondhand item this holiday season, including 70% of Gen Z and 78% of millennials, and 55% would rather receive a one-of-a-kind secondhand gift than a brand-new, mass-produced one. ThredUp will celebrate the launch with a series of holiday-themed livestreams during TikTok Shop’s Black Friday and Cyber Monday shopping event, running now through November 30.


Shop ThredUp live on TikTok Shop at[tiktok.com/@thredup](https://tiktok.com/@thredup) and follow the account for live notifications.


**About ThredUp**
ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world’s largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service® (RaaS®), some of the world’s leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry.
